summary: This setup defines the bank accounts of the institution where collected fees and other income will be deposited, allowing for accurate tracking and reporting of deposits per bank.
steps: Create masters for each of the institution's bank accounts (e.g., 'SBI', 'HDFC', 'ICICI').
business_rules: When recording a payment (e.g., fee, other income), the user must select the specific bank account where the money will be deposited.
Reports can be generated to show how much money has been deposited into each individual bank account.
important_notes: This configuration is crucial for financial reconciliation and accurate reporting of cash flows.
It helps in segregating funds received into different bank accounts.
questions: How do I add or manage the institution's bank accounts in the ERP system?
Where do I specify which bank account a fee payment is deposited into?
Can I get a report of deposits per bank account for reconciliation purposes?
What information is needed to set up an institute bank account?
